3.2.value: Mechanics as printed in FY2025 10-K (Item 5 - Share Repurchases; repeated in Note 14): CADENCE/PRICING DATE - repurchases only as of the opening of the last calendar day of each month (the 'Repurchase Date'); price = transaction price in effect on the Repurchase Date, generally the prior month's NAV per share, with a sole-discretion exception to reprice where NAV materially changed. EARLY EXIT - shares outstanding <1 year repurchased at 98% of transaction price (Early Repurchase Deduction), not applicable to DRIP shares. SETTLEMENT - generally within three business days of the Repurchase Date. CAPS - 2% of aggregate NAV/month, 5%/calendar quarter, both assessed each month. PRORATION - if requests exceed limits, repurchases are made pro rata AFTER first satisfying all requests due to death, disability or divorce and other limited exceptions; unsatisfied requests are NOT carried over - they 'must be resubmitted after the start of the next month or quarter, or upon the recommencement' of the plan. PRICE-AVAILABILITY GATE - if the transaction price is not made available by the tenth business day prior to the last business day of the month (or changed after), no requests are accepted that month. BOARD POWERS - may repurchase fewer shares than the caps or none, has made past exceptions, and may modify/suspend the plan. NOT PRINTED IN THE 10-K: the request-submission deadline and the stockholder's request-withdrawal window - those terms are in the Share Repurchase Plan / prospectus 'Share Repurchases' section (pointer: BREIT 424(b)(3) prospectus on EDGAR, CIK 1662972).

Global management-consulting firm profit-sharing/401(k) plan (~$9.8B, NY): filed outflow proxy 6.5% of the position per year, slider assumption 13.7%, stressed demand 19.2% vs 20% annual wrapper capacity, within wrapper capacity (19.2% vs 20%) IF offers are not prorated, but this issuer HAS prorated under stress (3.3). 6.1.value: Blackstone Real Estate Income Trust, Inc.: Maryland corporation incorporated November 16, 2015; non-listed, perpetual-life REIT (REIT election commencing taxable year ended December 31, 2017). UPREIT structure: BREIT is sole general partner of BREIT Operating Partnership L.P. ('BREIT OP'), a Delaware limited partnership, and owns substantially all assets through BREIT OP; share sale proceeds contributed to BREIT OP for corresponding-class units. Externally managed by BX REIT Advisors L.L.C., a subsidiary of Blackstone Inc.; BREIT Special Limited Partner L.P. (wholly-owned Blackstone subsidiary) holds the performance participation interest in BREIT OP. Nine reportable segments. DST Program (commenced November 2025): sells DST Interests in Delaware statutory trusts holding DST Properties via Section 4(a)(2)/Reg D private placements to accredited investors; each DST Property leased to a wholly-owned BREIT OP subsidiary under a master lease guaranteed by BREIT OP, with BREIT OP retaining a fair-market-value purchase option (FMV Option) to acquire DST Interests for OP units (or units plus cash). Also consolidates securitization vehicles ($6,975,460K real estate loans held at FV, Dec 31, 2025). Share classes: cumulative net proceeds of $80.2 billion through February 27, 2026 from sales of Class I, S, S-2, D, D-2, T, T-2, and C common stock across the continuous public offering and private offerings and BREIT OP units; per Item 5, Class C, L, L-2, and F shares are offered only in a private offering and are not offered in the Current Offering; no Class L, L-2, or F shares were outstanding as of December 31, 2025.
